svg.title: VAULT//SHIFT
svg.desc: VAULT//SHIFT. Status: Prototype. Private repository. A multiplayer sci-fi arena game for Roblox. The design: two teams fight over energy cores while reshaping the map.
svg.text: A Roblox arena game where two teams fight
over energy cores while the map reshapes
walls rise and fall on SHIFT,
Design sketch; the match loop is in a draft PR
